newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 17.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 17.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government decided not to allow a Chechen delegation to enter Estonia.
- The economic ministry is considering removing the Estonian Metal Export Company's monopoly on metal exports.
